summary: local-deep-research is a self-hosted FastAPI/Python deep-research assistant: users submit research queries that are run against web search engines and LLMs, generating reports; a per-user encrypted SQLCipher SQLite database persists research history, chat sessions, notes, a document library with RAG indexing (FAISS embeddings), news subscriptions, settings/API keys, usage metrics, and benchmarks.
